messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency SLO breached for service inference-gateway (eu-west-1). Current p99: 1.82s (SLO=1.5s). Streaming stalls and increased tail latency observed. Incident created INC-2024-347. Paging: @sre-rotation :rotating_light:

sam: I'm on it — grabbing traces and recent deploys. @erin can you join?

erin: joining. quick look at control-plane: config-fetch 5xx/504 spike starting ~1724509000. token-store auth errors also rising.

miguel: metrics: prefix-KV cache hit dropped 92% -> 49% for inference-gateway requests since 1724509050. eviction rate up x3.

jess: seeing customer reports: "stream halted mid-response" from a couple of PLG accounts. Not a full outage but bad UX.

sam: p95 went 420ms -> 760ms, p99 1.2s -> 1.82s. Error-rate (5xx) on control-plane up 0.4% -> 2.1%.

erin: looks like a config service slow tail + token-store rate limiting. stacktrace snippets show long waits on config fetch:

```
2024-03-24T17:03:22Z inference-gateway: fetchConfig(account=acct-9) elapsed=753ms
2024-03-24T17:03:23Z config-service svc: request timeout while reading flags
2024-03-24T17:03:24Z token-store: auth lookup latency=820ms status=504
```

miguel: also seeing a surge of feature-flag reads from a rollout key: ff/feature_streaming_v2 with traffic multiplier x5 starting 1724509020. Could be hammering configstore and causing cache churn.

paul: I rolled a canary for streaming_v2 at 16:58 — but only to 0.3% user traffic. Are we sure it's that?

sam: even small % but if it triggers heavy config/feature reads per request it can cascade. Check if rollout code touches config fetch per-token.

erin: checking code now — streaming path calls getFeatureFlags() per request to decide KV caching strategy. If flags miss cache we re-evaluate and hit configstore. that explains increased config fetch QPS + eviction.

jess: customer impact: a few sessions seeing >10s stalls (stream resume after retry), loss for realtime features. Might be ground for proactive notice.

sam: mitigation suggestions: 1) enable local fallback to last-known flags for streaming path 2) temporarily pause the streaming_v2 rollout or kill the canary 3) increase token-store and configstore read capacity / relax rate-limiter 4) add short TTL to per-request feature lookups (in-service)

miguel: I can flip a cached-fallback feature flag in the gateway (fast). pausing rollout needs Paul.

paul: pausing now — rollback canary to 0% at 17:18. Confirmed: rollout paused.

oncall-bot: NOTE: oncall handoff initiated. @sre-rotation takes ownership for live mitigation until resolved.

sre-rotation: taking over. Action plan: A) enable local flags fallback (miguel) B) relax configstore rate window for eu-west-1 proxy (erin) C) temporarily bump token-store read rate (paul ops) D) monitor p99/p95 and streaming error reports.

miguel: done — gateway fallback enabled at 17:22. pinging metrics.

erin: adjusting proxy rate window to 2s token bucket at 17:24. Applying in eu-west-1 control-plane proxy.

paul: token-store capacity knob bumped +20% at 17:25. Watching.

sam: after mitigations p95 dropped to ~480ms and p99 to 950ms within ~5-8 minutes. Streaming stalls reports reduced.

jess: customers with recent tickets notified: "We're aware of intermittent streaming stalls affecting a minority of sessions in EU; we've applied mitigations and are monitoring. We'll follow up with root cause." :white_check_mark:

sre-rotation: continuing monitoring for 30m. If stable, will close INC-2024-347 and open follow-up postmortem with action items: a) add per-request flag caching in SDK b) avoid per-token flag checks c) capacity planning for configstore + token-store and better backpressure d) add synthetic streaming smoke tests.

erin: assigning RCA owner: @sam. please include timeline, root cause (per-request flag reads -> cache churn -> configstore tail -> token auth delays -> streaming stalls), and mitigation checklist.

sam: ACK. I'll collect traces, flamegraphs, and the feature-flag rollout history. Expect initial RCA draft in the postmortem doc by EOD.

oncall-bot: Handoff note: incident remains open, owner=sre-rotation, severity=SEV3, customer-impact=partial-degradation.

sre-rotation: moving to monitoring channel; if p99 creeps back above 1.5s, we'll escalate to SEV2. For now keeping incident open.

jess: thanks all — I'll follow up with affected account contacts and update support tickets.

sam: adding a quick-blocking test to catch per-request feature flag hot-path in CI.

incident-bot: INC-2024-347 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Close candidate after 30m stable.

sre-rotation: logging final note here before we archive: root cause appears to be a change in streaming path that did expensive per-request feature flag fetches. That pattern amplified cache misses on configstore which cascaded into auth token-store delays and caused tail stalls. Mitigations: fallback enabled, rollout paused, capacity bumped. Postmortem tasks assigned.

sam: thanks team. :bow:
